summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser and its tests; nothing committed. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py (parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError) and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. The new tests and the existing test/test_path.py pass: 42 passed. Not verified: mypy, ruff and black are not installed in the shared venv, so the type-ignore comments and formatting were checked by reading only (line lengths checked with awk, all within 88 columns). Open concern: the spec says None makes graph value lookups return nothing, but in rdflib value(None, ...) acts as a wildcard. The None test passes on the test graph, but I did not confirm this holds for every graph; no special handling was added, as the spec requires.
